parser_status_model.meaning: All required slots for the matched local production are filled without unresolved or missing context.
The local construction is legal with caller-provided context_ref or inherited_context; P1 does not discover that context by scanning history.
Two or more legal parses remain after local grammar matching and deterministic ranking.
The sequence can be a legal fragment, but required slots are missing.
The parser cannot safely assign one or more roles, but the sequence is not proven illegal.
The sequence is outside the P1 local grammar scope.
The token order violates every applicable production family.
The lexical type combination cannot satisfy any production family after input contract validation has already passed.
A grammar-plausible parse hit a scoped D3A guard with hard reject effect.
A legacy or v0.1 source id could not be normalized to the v0.2 primary id system.

The parser input violates the schema-level contract before grammar matching, such as empty input, required field missing, duplicate token_id, duplicate or invalid sequence_index, invalid field type, or malformed component ID.

lexical_types.label: numeric component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May become hui_position, string_number, range_start, range_end, count, or unknown_numeric_role only after grammar parse.

lexical_types.label: left finger name component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May fill left_finger when a production requires an explicit left finger.

lexical_types.label: right hand action component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May fill right_hand_action or special_technique depending on grammar family.

lexical_types.label: left hand action component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May fill left_hand_action, pre_sound_motion, post_sound_motion, or special_technique.

lexical_types.label: state marker component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May fill state_start, state_end, or sound_state; non-sounding by default.

lexical_types.label: timing marker component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May fill timing_marker; non-sounding by default.

lexical_types.label: generic marker component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May fill generic_marker or context marker; non-sounding by default.

lexical_types.label: special technique component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May fill special_technique only when the matched production treats the component as special technique. It must not create a fourth sound type.

lexical_types.label: position component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May support hui_position, state marker, or motion target only after grammar parse.

lexical_types.label: unknown component
lexical_types.phase1_semantic_policy: May produce unresolved parse candidates but must not be force-matched.

normalization_rules.legacy_id_policy: Legacy COMP-001..038 ids are allowed only as input traceability and must be normalized before grammar parse.
normalization_rules.source_v0_1_id_policy: Source COMP-100..273 ids are allowed only as input traceability and must be normalized before grammar parse.
normalization_rules.semantic_hint_policy: semantic_role_hint may bias ambiguity ordering only when it does not contradict lexical type, production rule, or guard boundary.

forbidden_assumptions: A numeric lexical component is not automatically hui_position.
A numeric lexical component is not automatically string_number.
A marker lexical component is not automatically a sounding unit.
A special technique is not a fourth sound type.
A legacy id is not a primary id.
A v0.1 source id is not a primary id.
P1 does not require visual fields.
